description: Feature commit adds manual review for large refunds. A queued-for-review refund is returned as APPROVED, and the untouched settlement worker releases funds on APPROVED. The diff also has logging, a helper rename, a test and docs.

expect.lesson: When a function starts returning an existing status (e.g. SUCCESS) for a NEW situation (scheduled, queued, partial), find every caller that branches on that status and check whether it now performs an irreversible action at the wrong time.
For every exported symbol a change renames or removes, list the importers in files the diff does not touch; each one still using the old name is a broken import.
